PERFORMANCE PLEDGE/SERVICE COMMITMENT
As integrated in Legazpi City’s broader Charter, the ABE Division pledge to serve the farmers and
fisherfolk through applying engineering principles to improve agriculture, food production, natural
resources, and environmental management.
